title: How to clean a toothbrush holder

pieces.say: Your toothbrush cup is hiding a slimy secret.
pieces.text: Your toothbrush cup is hiding a slimy secret.
pieces.label: HIDDEN GRIME

pieces.say: Here's the hidden spot. The gunk pools at the bottom.
Empty it and rinse out the gunk.
Scrub inside with hot soapy water and a bottle brush.
Rinse, and let it dry completely.
Dishwasher only if the label says so, and never mix cleaners.
Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.
